core_categories: Medical Devices; Healthcare Products; Homecare Services; Logistics Services; Own Brand Products
specialty_focus: Mediq is a European medical device and healthcare logistics provider that supplies medical products, equipment, and direct-to-patient homecare services to general practitioners, clinics, and hospitals. It operates across 13 European countries, managing proprietary product lines and acting as an exclusive sales and logistics partner for major medical manufacturers. Mediq does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices; its core business is broader medical supply distribution and homecare.
key_brands: Klinion, Absorin, Curion, 365 Healthcare, Mediq Select, Cardinal Health, Zorflex, PolyMem, Nursicare, BODE / Hartmann Group, others
